title: The mantis shrimp punch

scenes.headline: This shrimp punches at up to 23 m/s.

scenes.label: the pull of gravity, at peak acceleration

scenes.headline: A spring, not just muscle
scenes.body: A saddle-shaped spring in its exoskeleton stores energy, then releases it in one strike.

scenes.headline: Then the bubbles hit
scenes.body: The strike creates collapsing vapour bubbles (cavitation) that may help break snail shells.

caption:
Snails never see it coming.

Patek's team filmed the strike at 5,000 frames per second; peak speeds ranged from 14 to 23 metres per second.

Source: Patek, Korff & Caldwell 2004, Nature; UC Berkeley News. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Photo-only fact-over-footage with a closing chart; every number is from the original Nature study. Original because the designed overlay is the content.
